name: Story structure
description: Use when shaping what a video says: a hook, a build and a payoff, every part earning its place, and what to cut when everything seems good. Keep the speaker's meaning; never change it.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.

evals.ask: Help me with the story structure of my video
I can't decide what to cut, it all seems good
Refactor the folder structure of the repo
Add a git hook for linting
